title: Practice 8: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: A cockroach has climbed up on me!
exercises.why: **залез** — past tense (masculine) of залезть: perfective (imperfective partner: залезать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The water came up to our necks.
exercises.why: **дошла** — past tense (feminine) of дойти: perfective (imperfective partner: доходить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: I've decided to tell on Tom.
exercises.why: **донести** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: доносить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: We'll put you on the list.
exercises.why: **внесем** — future tense (1st person plural) of внести: perfective (imperfective partner: вносить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The bird escaped from its cage.
exercises.why: **сбежала** — past tense (feminine) of сбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: сбегать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: She's a little slow on the uptake.
exercises.why: **доходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of доходить: imperfective (perfective partner: дойти).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: The house was carried away by the flood.
exercises.why: **унесло** — past tense (neuter) of унести: perfective (imperfective partner: уносить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom escaped easily.
exercises.why: **сбежал** — past tense (masculine) of сбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: сбегать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: I'll come on Monday.
exercises.why: **приду** — future tense (1st person singular) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I walked out of the movie.
exercises.why: **вышел** — past tense (masculine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The train was derailed.
exercises.why: **сошёл** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: I'll drive you somewhere.
exercises.why: **отвезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: Let's go out on the balcony.
exercises.why: **выйдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: **влетела** — past tense (feminine) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Tom leaves for Barcelona by plane.
exercises.why: **улетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of улетать: imperfective (perfective partner: улететь).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: I will marry you.
exercises.why: **выйду** — future tense (1st person singular) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Mayuko entered the room.
exercises.why: **вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The custom originated in China.
exercises.why: **исходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of исходить: imperfective.  Prefix **из-, изо-, ис-**: movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: The baby crept into the room.
exercises.why: **заполз** — past tense (masculine) of заползти: perfective (imperfective partner: заползать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The river flowed over its banks.
exercises.why: **вышла** — past tense (feminine) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
